sections.title: Panes
sections.blurb: A pane is one terminal inside a window. Splitting a pane makes two.

sections.title: Windows
sections.blurb: A window is a full-screen tab, listed along the bottom bar.

sections.title: Sessions
sections.blurb: A session is a whole set of windows. It keeps running after the terminal window closes, and resurrect brings it back after a reboot.

sections.title: Copy mode and scrollback
sections.blurb: Scroll back through output, search it and copy from it. Emacs-style keys here; the mouse works too.

sections.title: Mouse and trackpad
sections.blurb: The MX Master's buttons (Solaar rules) and trackpad gestures.

sections.title: Apps and menus
sections.blurb: Launchers and the pickers on top of them.

sections.title: Notifications
sections.blurb: mako, the notification pills at the top right.

sections.title: Sound, light and media
sections.blurb: The function-row keys. Shift moves them from the speakers to the microphone.

sections.title: Workspaces and monitors
sections.blurb: Numbered desktops, the scratchpad and moving between screens.

sections.title: Windows
sections.blurb: Windows tile on their own. These move, float, resize and close them.
